description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial Disputes between R. P. I. H. Rajapakse Malabe and other part National Institute of Plantation Management Athurugiriya - Appoint A. B. Herath, Matale to be the Arbitrator for settlement by Arbitration - Appoint K. A. Thilakarathne, Piliyandala to be the Arbitrator for settlement by Arbitration (S & E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically the revocation and issuance of orders for arbitration in industrial disputes. It involves statutory instruments (orders under Section 4(1) of the Act) and legal procedures for dispute resolution, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. While it mentions a minister's name (Manusha Nanayakkara), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than detailing portfolio responsibilities or making personnel appointments, so it does not qualify as a government-related type (1-3).
